items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: So I went up. Redd said, sit down, have a drink... I always wanted to shake hands and say thank you.

ctx.x: But it was that kind of thing. You know, just a joke back and forth. And the last night Jerome came down, Richardson, he was the contractor. He said, "Redd wants to see you up in his dressing room." I said, "Why?" And he said, "I don't know, I didn't ask him." So I went up. Redd said, sit down, have a drink, he gave me a drink. He said, "You know, I've been hearing about you from black musicians for years." And I said, "What do you mean?" He said, "That thing you did 20 years ago with the Chesterfield thing, with…
